answer: A stake-and-reputation grove works like a living mesa: every agent must lock a refundable deposit of onyx-graded tokens before it can trade, and each successful deal grows its reputation while a proven fraud burns the deposit and wipes the record. One identity can therefore only buy one trading history, so an attacker who wants a hundred fake agents must fund a hundred separate deposits and build a hundred honest histories first — the cost multiplies with every identity, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the deposit they get back.
